welcome:
🕌 **Islamic Unified Bot**

Assalamu Alaikum! I am your comprehensive Islamic companion.

I can help you with:
📿 Adhkar & Duas
📖 Quran streaming & reading
🕌 Accurate prayer times
📜 Hadith collection
🤲 99 Names of Allah
🧮 Zakat calculator
📅 Hijri calendar

Use the buttons below or type /help
help:
🆘 **Help**

**Main Commands:**
/start - Main menu
/help - This help

**📿 Adhkar:**
/adhkar - Browse adhkar

**📖 Quran:**
/quran - Browse surahs
/radio - Quran radio (groups)

**🕌 Prayer:**
/azan_setup - Setup your city
/azan_times - Today's prayer times
/azan_next - Next prayer
/azan_settings - Azan settings
/azan_search <city> - Search city

**🤲 Islamic Tools:**
/names - 99 Names of Allah
/hadith - Hadith collection
/dua - Supplications
/zakat - Zakat calculator
/hijri - Hijri date
/jummah - Friday info
/memorize - Quran memorization
/glossary - Islamic glossary
/tasbih - Digital tasbih
/prayer - Prayer times
/monthly - Monthly schedule
about:
🤖 **About the Bot**

**Islamic Unified Bot v2**

A comprehensive Telegram bot for the Muslim community.

Features:
✅ Accurate prayer times
✅ Azan notifications
✅ Quran audio streaming
✅ Morning & evening adhkar
✅ Hadith library
✅ 99 Names of Allah
✅ Zakat calculator
✅ Hijri calendar
✅ Quran memorization aid
✅ 50+ languages

Made with ❤️ for the global Muslim community.
